layer.name: Unsafe facades
layer.description: Buildings whose newest facade inspection filing has the status UNSAFE, or SWARMP (safe with a repair and maintenance program). One mark per building; the status is the one on record at the pull and the date is that filing's. The inspection program covers buildings taller than six stories, so a building with no mark was not necessarily inspected. Not on the map: 16 of 7,153 buildings (the lot is in neither PLUTO nor the tax map). Pulled 2026-11-14.
